How does 3rd option is also correct?(Week - 1 GA 12th qn)

posts.name: Manish Kumar
posts.cooked:
The path: /home/user/data.txt

Splitting by '/' using cut command gives:

Field Value
1 (empty — before first /)
2 home
3 user
4 data.txt

So when you use -f4, it picks the 4th field, which is indeed data.txt.

posts.name: Manish Kumar
posts.cooked:
<<< $file sends the value of $file to the stdin of cut.

it means it take value of file and give stdin to given command
